4th Period.workingNow: Testing your partner's Mario for state bugs while they test yours.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: week06-state-pattern.md in your Mario fork — a working small/big toggle plus a short write-up naming your states, your triggers, and what changes in each — committed by Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can test my state machine with edge cases so that I can find and fix bugs before my write-up is due.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.17 — Systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.3 — Offering and supporting opinions and negotiating with others in communicative exchanges.
agenda: I do: how to break a state machine on purpose (10 min)
We do: run one test case as a class (8 min)
You do: partner test — driver & tester roles (22 min)
Exit Ticket: one bug you found and fixed (5 min)
4th Period.connections: Your state machine works when everything goes right. Today you and a partner try to break each other's — spam the key, press it mid-animation — because the bugs you find now are the ones you will not be explaining away later. Tomorrow you document the pattern.

6th Period.workingNow: Playing a classmate's game and writing them one specific, useful note — then fixing your own.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Your finished game, published from Code.org Game Lab and embedded on your Google Site with a one-paragraph description — link shared by Sunday night.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can give and use specific playtest feedback so that my game feels the way I planned it to feel.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.15 — Seek and incorporate feedback from team members and users to refine a solution that meets user needs.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.3 — Offering and supporting opinions and negotiating with others in communicative exchanges.
agenda: I do: what a useful playtest note sounds like (8 min)
We do: practice one note as a class (5 min)
You do: swap games — play, note, then revise (25 min)
Exit Ticket: one change you are making (5 min)
6th Period.connections: Yesterday you found your own bugs. Today someone else plays your game and tells you whether the feeling you chose on your MDA sheet actually comes through. Tomorrow you publish it to your Google Site.
